description: This file defines a utility function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes raw aggregate records into a format suitable for visualization with Recharts. It groups data by agent name and a secondary dimension ('environment' or 'cost_category'), filling in missing categories with zero to ensure consistent bar groups.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries
methods.description: Transforms raw records into a grouped dataset suitable for charting, with options for sorting and labeling.
